## Orientation

Repo path (code only): `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--phase-reviewer`. Commit on `phase/phase-reviewer` excluding `.artifacts`. Do not edit `.artifacts/` or call `adaptive-artifacts`. Wave mate `status-tabs-fixture` is waiting — you own `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md`, `se_workflow/` orchestration helpers (keep `reviewer.py` brief builder), and execute/parent/gate/fix/integration tests in `tests/test_phase_reviewer.py`. Do not implement the status-tabs fixture.

Requirements:
R1: Ship agents/se-reviewer.md ... execute-phase invokes it once at phase end after the closing verification task and before merge (and before tier-2 when that phase exists).
R3: The reviewer itself writes nothing to the store. The parent records one project:check-run with method: review, evidence_kind: review, revision = phase head, result pass|fail from the verdict, and one project:finding per NEEDS_WORK item.
R4: NEEDS_WORK findings of kinds that are fixable become fix work-items via the retry-loop fix-task mechanism and budget; the reviewer re-runs once on the new diff; budget exhaustion escalates to the user.
R5: The phase gate requires a passing review check-run at the phase head SHA before merge (and before tier-2 when present).
R6: The phase integration report content is produced from the reviewer's structured output (parent still writes the record).

Design Invariants:
- Reviewer writes no store records.
- Single writer remains the parent.
- done tasks are not reopened; gaps are new fix tasks.

Design Assumptions:
- Host supports tool restriction for the reviewer agent; if Cursor cannot match Claude Code agents/, the skill documents the fallback and still forbids writes in the prompt.
- retry-loop fix-task and budget machinery is available when this phase executes.

Decisions:
- phase-reviewer-scope: Phase-end core reviewer; defer per-task review and pre-dispatch coverage check
- reviewer-inputs: Specs, acceptances, invariants, and phase diff only; no builder self-grades
